text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Pitfalls leading to the extraordinary are 
everywhere. It all began when I went to 
the school store to buy snacks for 
training...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...! The last one is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm...? You guys were aiming for this too? 
Out of luck, little lady.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, it's first come, first served. Though 
I was curious about the new "Soba Manju" 
flavor...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It is regrettable. It was a flavor she 
had been looking forward to. It will 
likely affect her motivation as well...
choice_data_list:
(I really wanted to get it for her no 
matter what!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Are you sure about that? Giving 
up, I mean. The look in your eyes... seems 
to tell a different story from your meek 
demeanor, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't realized, should I tell 
you? It's the madness sleeping inside you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Someone like you would become a demon for 
the sake of your Umamusume...! Ha, looks 
like you're gonna give me one hell of a 
thrill.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
N-Nakayama-san? What on earth are you 
talking about...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, care for a game? If you beat me, 
I'll let you have that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer...! What kind of game 
are you planning to play?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Rolling the dice is where the fun is at! 
Come on, even if you lose, you won't lose 
a thing. Now, bring it on...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Nakayama Festa say that, I felt a 
strange impulse well up inside me. If it's 
for Buena Vista, I can handle this 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And changing the venue, a bloody, 
cutthroat battle began—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“—Turn end! From now on, the field enters 
the 『Cold Terrain』 state, which favors 
this one! Now, how will you struggle 
against it!?”
choice_data_list:
No sweat!! If it's snowing, I'll just run 
around the yard!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I-Is this the "Dog Game"...?! What on 
earth is happening...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Leather Jacket
text_block_list.text:
Hyahaaaaa! Well, this is a surprise! Who 
knew the academy would turn into a 
lawless, no-holds-barred dog run~~!

text_block_list.name: Spiky Shoulder Pad Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hee-hee-hee-hee-hee! Get 'em! Shedding fur 
during molting season ain't just for show, 
ya know~~?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know... But I can tell it's a 
fierce battle...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Both of you... Please come back safely...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The battle was plunged into absolute 
chaos. Even so, she held on for dear life, 
searching for a path to victory within the 
bizarrely complex rules...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, trying to cancel it out with a flashy 
light show...! How naive! I have a dog 
whistle!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Leather Jacket
text_block_list.text:
"And that's game! Hehehe! Nakayama's 
brushing technique is merciless!!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What?! You're still standing back up...! 
We should've run out of reward snacks long 
ago...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!? ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At that moment, there was the sound of a 
small drop falling. A crystal-like 
brilliance begins to illuminate the 
desolate dog run (?)...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Please...! No more, I can't...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't let the battle consume 
you... Remember the kind Big Brother you 
always are.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't let the battle consume 
you... Remember the kind Big Sister you 
always are.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be fine... So... please don't push 
yourself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice brought me back to my senses—! 
The surroundings fell dead silent, and 
light shone down upon the world.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Leather Jacket
text_block_list.text:
Why was our blood boiling like that...? It 
feels like I was having some crazy 
dream...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And once her head cleared, she thought 
about it... and realized something! 
Grabbing the dog plushie, she stood up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! I see...! That period of silence 
triggers the special rule!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh no!! It's the "Dig-Here Defense"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOF!!!) (Woooof...!!) (Woof...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Hah, I lost... A blow from outside the 
ring, what an unexpected ambush.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...! Hold on, both of you, pull yourselves 
together! *sniff*... To get so beat up 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista looks at me with concern. The 
battle had ended, yes... thanks to her 
tears working a miracle—
choice_data_list: Don't worry. Smile for me, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista looks at me with concern. The 
battle had ended, yes... thanks to her 
tears working a miracle—
choice_data_list: Don't worry. Smile for me, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Trying to act cool looking like 
that. Still, I'm glad... everyone is safe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really can't beat you. To think 
those beautiful tears of yours, little 
lady, could rewrite everything like this.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...Thank you, for doing this for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the bloody, desperate struggle 
came to an end! The beauty of her tears 
saved the world itself. — The End —

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...!? Um, wh-what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's strange...? Huh...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly felt like you were going off to 
a different world, so I just...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It just shows how serious they were. 
Heh... your Trainer's got some real guts, 
don't they?
